description: Context Snapshot & Diff - Track token growth over time with snapshots
steps: Create lib/utils/snapshot-manager.js with SnapshotStore, SnapshotDiff, and SnapshotManager classes
acceptance_criteria: --snapshot flag creates a snapshot with message
--diff-last compares current state with last snapshot
Growth trend displayed with text-based graphs
verification: Run npm test and confirm all tests pass (1078 tests)
Manually test snapshot creation and diff
findings: Implemented complete snapshot system with 39 new tests. Features include: snapshot creation with unique IDs, snapshot listing, diff comparison between snapshots and current state, trend analysis with ASCII charts, and JSON export support. All snapshots stored in .ctxman/snapshots/ directory.
